title: Moroccan Couscous with Oceanic Salad
description: A hearty and flavorful North African-inspired dish featuring roasted oceanic vegetables and a crispy couscous salad.

ingredients.name: oceanic (such as zucchini, bell peppers and eggplant)

instructions: Toss oceanic with olive oil, moroccan spice blend, salt, and pepper. Roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
Cook couscous according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat a small amount of olive oil and sauté crisp until tender.
Combine cooked couscous and crisp. Toss with roasted oceanic.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
